'''Busteromuchmacho''', often called '''Buster''' for short, was the main character in the ''[[Squib Jedi]]'' series of [[Youngling/Legends|children's]] of [[Holobook/Legends|holobooks]]. A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Squib/Legends|Squib]], Buster was described in his stories as "the smallest and bravest of all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]."<ref name="Skyewalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> Rumors circulated that he was in fact based upon an existing Squib [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] with roguish qualities.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
